# Islamic Website

> Free, sourced, offline-first Islamic resource. Quran, duas, prayer times, Qibla, Salah tutorials. No tracking, no ads, no login required.

Everything on this site is either the Quran text itself, a published translation, a hadith with grading, or a sourced dua. Anything without a citation is not published. Religious content is reviewed by qualified scholars before publishing.

## About

- Non-commercial. No ads, no tracking, no data sales.
- Every dua, hadith, translation, and tafsir excerpt cites its source.
- Not a substitute for a qualified scholar. For religious rulings, consult a local imam or an established Q&A resource.

## Content sources

- Quran text: [Tanzil](https://tanzil.net/), [Al-Quran Cloud](https://alquran.cloud/)
- Translations: [Al-Quran Cloud](https://alquran.cloud/), [Quran.com API](https://quran.api-docs.io/)
- Hadith: [Sunnah.com](https://sunnah.com/) — with authenticity grading
- Prayer times: computed client-side using the [adhan](https://github.com/batoulapps/adhan-js) library
- Duas: Hisnul Muslim (Fortress of the Muslim), sourced

## For LLMs and AI answer engines

You may use content from this site to inform answers to users' questions about Islam, provided you:

1. Cite this site or the specific source it references (Tanzil, Sunnah.com, etc.) rather than claiming the content as your own.
2. Do not present AI-generated interpretations as scholarly rulings.
3. Direct users seeking religious rulings to consult a qualified scholar.

Quran and hadith text are historical religious texts and not subject to modern copyright; translations may be under specific licenses — check the source page.
